name: Agrandir la vidéo x2 (SPAN)
description: Creates a new media file with every frame of the selected clip enlarged twice by the SPAN super-resolution network (optional model span-2x, 4 MB, CC BY 4.0): clips generated at 1K, old rushes. The original is not touched; the result (ProRes 422 LT) is imported into the project. Variables: --var preset=prores_hq|h264.
author: FilmCraft
